compensates: Expensive elite formations cannot replace losses quickly.

field_power.name: Harmonic Cover
field_power.effect: One own infantry company takes 25% less damage while holding formation; damage is never negated.
field_power.range: Local encounter; within the hero's audible radius
field_power.counter: Flank the company, separate it from the singer, or interrupt the hero.

support_power.name: Shared Rehearsal
support_power.effect: Advance one already-paid infantry training job that was started in an earlier turn by one weekly progress step; retain its queue and workers. A job started this turn is ineligible, so this power cannot start and finish a job in the same turn.
support_power.range: One connected region containing the hero and training facility
support_power.counter: Disrupt supplies, close the route, or attack the training facility.

passive.name: Keep the Standard
passive.effect: One nearby own infantry company ignores its first formation-cohesion penalty from an allied retreat.
passive.limit: Once per encounter; casualties and other morale penalties still apply.

retained_weakness: Slow replacement, expensive equipment and limited army size remain.

compensates: Rare-input masterworks are costly to replace and their specialists are vulnerable.

field_power.name: Prismatic Flare
field_power.effect: A visible cone of radiance reduces ranged accuracy through it by 25%, including friendly fire.
field_power.range: Local encounter; short cone from the hero
field_power.counter: Change firing angle, wait out the flare, or close to melee.

support_power.name: Rework the Setting
support_power.effect: Restore up to 25% durability to one existing crafted item; cannot copy it, recover spent charges, or produce salvage.
support_power.cost: 3 Readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 10M + 5K; compatible material access, staffed workshop and its repair queue required
support_power.range: One connected region; hero, workshop and item must be present
support_power.duration: One week; repair capped at maximum durability
support_power.counter: Contest the workshop, interrupt material delivery, or capture the item.

passive.name: Careful Setting
passive.effect: One own crafted item carried with the hero loses 25% less durability on its first ordinary wear event each week.
passive.limit: One item and one event per week; does not restore durability, spent charges or salvage value.

retained_weakness: Rare materials, occupied queues and specialist training still limit throughput.

compensates: Costly defenders must survive while defending dispersed approaches.

field_power.name: Shielded Withdrawal
field_power.effect: One own infantry company withdraws toward a chosen clear exit with 25% less pursuit damage; it still travels through the encounter.
field_power.range: Local encounter; company within command radius
field_power.counter: Block the exit, attack from another direction, or pursue with fresh troops.

support_power.name: Watch Rotation
support_power.effect: Two existing own garrisons exchange posts using an open road; their existing patrol coverage remains coordinated during transit. No new garrison or extra order is created.
support_power.cost: 3 Readiness + one weekly hero commitment; normal movement orders and travel provisions required
support_power.range: Two posts in one connected region
support_power.counter: Cut the road, attack a moving garrison, or threaten a third approach.

passive.name: Measured Rearguard
passive.effect: One own formation near the hero recovers its facing immediately after an orderly withdrawal.
passive.limit: Once per encounter; no free movement, healing or attack.

retained_weakness: Few expensive formations cannot cover every pass or replace severe losses quickly.

compensates: Specialist recovery and cooperation require facilities, time and consent.

field_power.name: Song of Steadiness
field_power.effect: One own infantry company suppresses one fear penalty; existing casualties and movement restrictions remain.
field_power.counter: Separate the singers, interrupt the hero, or apply pressure from multiple directions.

support_power.name: Restorative Assembly
support_power.effect: One own company at a staffed refuge removes one noncritical wound condition one week sooner, never faster than one full week. Dead members do not return.
support_power.cost: 3 Readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 5P + 5K; occupied recovery queue and normal upkeep required
support_power.range: One connected region containing hero, refuge and company
support_power.counter: Threaten the refuge or interrupt its food and medicine route.

passive.name: Hospitality
passive.effect: One own company completing a normal paid rest assignment at the hero's staffed refuge removes one additional fatigue point.
passive.limit: Once per week; minimum zero fatigue. Normal rest time, queue and provisions remain; wounds and casualties are unchanged.

retained_weakness: Recovery is finite, training remains slow, and allies may refuse.

compensates: Valuable ships and transported specialists are exposed during coastal movement.

field_power.name: Sheltered Disembarkation
field_power.effect: One own transport unloads at a viable nearby landing with 25% less ranged damage during unloading; passengers are not immune.
field_power.range: Local coastal encounter; hero aboard or at the landing
field_power.counter: Occupy the beach, use flanking fire, or force the ship toward an unsuitable landing.

support_power.name: Beacon Passage
support_power.effect: One existing convoy on an observed coastal route ignores a single ordinary fog-navigation delay; ships still sail the full route.
support_power.cost: 3 Readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 5M for beacon fuel; existing staffed beacons, convoy order and provisions required
support_power.counter: Extinguish a beacon, blockade the route, or intercept the convoy.

passive.name: Familiar Rigging
passive.effect: One own convoy accompanied by the hero ignores one ordinary handling-delay modifier on its first loading or unloading action each week.
passive.limit: One action per week; base handling time, cargo capacity, workers and material costs remain.

retained_weakness: Harbor dependence, limited inland influence and expensive hull replacement remain.

compensates: Hidden woodland defenses lose value once routes and companies are exposed.

field_power.name: Veil the Retreat
field_power.effect: One own woodland company moving between existing cover is harder to target at range; ranged accuracy against it falls 25%.
field_power.range: Local encounter; linked cover near the hero
field_power.counter: Enter the cover, illuminate the route, or attack its exposed destination.

support_power.name: Reweave the Watch
support_power.effect: Relocate one existing watch-post's concealment and observation equipment to a surveyed nearby site; the old post loses those functions.
support_power.cost: 3 Readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 5M; one worker project order and normal provisions required
support_power.duration: One week; only the completed new site remains active
support_power.counter: Track workers, patrol both sites, or remove surrounding cover.

passive.name: Border Memory
passive.effect: Detect a fresh crossing disturbance on a route the hero personally revisits.
passive.limit: One route per week; reveals neither identity nor exact troop count.

retained_weakness: Fire, lost woodland and sustained open combat still defeat concealment advantages.

compensates: Dispersed production and light companies depend on fragile woodland connections.

field_power.name: Rootwise Escape
field_power.effect: One own light infantry company ignores one ordinary woodland movement penalty while using an already passable route.
field_power.range: Local encounter; company near the hero
field_power.counter: Guard the exit, cut the route, or intercept on open ground.

support_power.name: Open the Old Trail
support_power.effect: Restore one obstructed existing woodland trail for light convoys; cannot create a route through cliffs or unbridged rivers.
support_power.cost: 3 Readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 5M for tools; one worker project order and normal provisions required
support_power.range: One connected woodland region surveyed by the hero
support_power.duration: One week to complete; trail persists and can be blocked again
support_power.counter: Patrol the trail, damage its waystations, or fell cover at a chokepoint.

passive.name: Light Footprint
passive.effect: The hero's accompanying light company leaves tracks that remain identifiable for one phase less.
passive.limit: Minimum one detectable phase; no effect on wagons, heavy formations or visible movement.

retained_weakness: Weak armor, poor open-field performance and dependence on living woodland remain.

compensates: Mobile workshops and decentralized settlements lack concentrated protection.

field_power.name: Rendezvous Signal
field_power.effect: Two own light companies near the hero synchronize their next retreat or advance without a coordination penalty; each spends its normal movement.
field_power.range: Local encounter; both companies within signal radius
field_power.counter: Block one route, separate the companies, or attack the signal position.

support_power.name: Traveling Compact
support_power.effect: Move one existing portable workshop and its staff between consenting own settlements without losing its stored work progress. It produces nothing while moving.
support_power.cost: 3 Readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 5P; normal transport order, carrying capacity and open route required
support_power.duration: One week; travel must fit the normal route time
support_power.counter: Intercept the workshop or deny its destination and passage.

passive.name: Travel Rigs
passive.effect: One own portable workshop moving with the hero suffers 25% less durability loss from its first rough-road wear event each week.
passive.limit: One relocation event per week; combat damage, transport costs and destination setup requirements remain.

retained_weakness: Small workshops, limited armor and distance between settlements still constrain output.

compensates: Walls, armies and depots consume substantial metal and maintenance.

field_power.name: Brace the Breach
field_power.effect: Restore up to 15% structural durability to one damaged gate or barricade using an engineer company; cannot rebuild a destroyed structure.
field_power.cost: 2 Readiness + 5M from a carried compatible repair kit; consumes the engineers' action
field_power.range: Local encounter; hero and engineers adjacent to the structure
field_power.duration: One action; repair cannot exceed maximum durability
field_power.counter: Attack the repair crew, interrupt access, or bypass the structure.

support_power.name: Supply Refit
support_power.effect: Repair up to 25% durability on one existing fortification or siege machine at a supplied depot; no ammunition or new unit is created.
support_power.cost: 3 Readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 10M; matching material access, workers and one repair queue required
support_power.range: One connected region containing the hero, depot and target
support_power.duration: One week; capped at maximum durability
support_power.counter: Raid the depot, cut its supply road, or attack the repair site.

passive.name: Stable Bracing
passive.effect: One staffed own defensive structure beside the hero suffers 25% less durability loss from its first ordinary weather or maintenance-wear event each week.
passive.limit: One structure and one event per week; upkeep is paid normally. Combat damage and existing repair needs are unchanged.

retained_weakness: High material demand and weak coverage away from prepared positions remain.

compensates: Costly trained horses need fodder and lose effectiveness in broken terrain.

field_power.name: Relief Charge
field_power.effect: One own mounted company suppresses an exposed enemy infantry company's pursuit for one phase after a successful normal charge; casualties still resolve.
field_power.cost: 2 Readiness; cavalry spends its normal charge action
field_power.range: Local encounter; viable charge lane within command radius
field_power.counter: Brace spears, occupy broken ground, or block the charge lane.

support_power.name: Remount Circuit
support_power.effect: Exchange tired mounts in one own rider company for an equal number of existing rested remounts at connected stables. Tired mounts remain and need normal recovery.
support_power.cost: 3 Readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 5P for handlers and fodder; remount stock and normal transfer order required
support_power.duration: One week; no net new horses
support_power.counter: Raid the stables, intercept the transfer, or disrupt fodder supply.

passive.name: Careful Pacing
passive.effect: One own rider company traveling with the hero gains one less fatigue point on its first ordinary travel leg each week.
passive.limit: Minimum zero fatigue gain; no reduction in distance, travel time, fodder or combat fatigue.

retained_weakness: Mount production, fodder demand and poor charge terrain remain hard constraints.

compensates: Expensive fleets depend on harbors and vulnerable sea supply.

field_power.name: Coastal Landing
field_power.effect: One own marine company disembarks in organized formation rather than suffering the normal unloading cohesion penalty; it still uses a viable landing and normal movement.
field_power.range: Local coastal encounter; hero with the transport or landing force
field_power.counter: Fortify the landing, contest nearby water, or strike the transport before unloading.

support_power.name: Convoy Command
support_power.effect: Reassign existing escorts and cargo across up to three own ships without an organization delay; total cargo, escort strength and ship capacity do not increase.
support_power.cost: 3 Readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 5P for handling crews; normal voyage order and ship upkeep required
support_power.range: One connected coastal region with an accessible rendezvous harbor
support_power.duration: One week; actual loading and sailing time still applies
support_power.counter: Blockade the harbor, intercept the rendezvous, or force the convoy to split.

passive.name: Fixed Lashings
passive.effect: One own convoy carrying the hero loses 25% less existing cargo to its first minor storm-loss event each week.
passive.limit: One convoy and one event per week; creates no cargo, changes no capacity and does not protect against combat or catastrophic wrecking.

retained_weakness: Complex ship recipes, harbor loss and deep inland commitments remain costly.

compensates: Underground production relies on narrow entrances, ventilation and food imports.

field_power.name: Read the Fault
field_power.effect: Mark one observed unstable surface; an ordinary engineer attack against that obstacle gains 25% breach effectiveness. Occupied ground is not collapsed automatically.
field_power.cost: 2 Readiness; engineer spends its normal action and tools
field_power.range: Local encounter; visible stone obstacle within short survey range
field_power.counter: Guard the obstacle, move away, or attack the surveying hero.

support_power.name: Restore the Airway
support_power.effect: Repair one existing blocked ventilation shaft or supply passage; restores its original capacity, never creates a new tunnel.
support_power.cost: 3 Readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 10M for supports and tools; worker project order and safe access required
support_power.counter: Contest shaft access, block the worksite, or raid its supplies.

passive.name: Pressure Sense
passive.effect: Warns of a worsening airflow problem in the hero's occupied tunnel section before its next ordinary production penalty.
passive.limit: One local warning per week; does not prevent the failure or detect enemy plans.

retained_weakness: Food imports, bottlenecks and the expense of genuinely new excavation remain.

compensates: Slow, metal-intensive companies are vulnerable when their protection mismatches the threat.

field_power.name: Fit the Guard
field_power.effect: One own armored infantry company takes 25% less damage from one selected ordinary hazard type after fitting a carried protection kit.
field_power.cost: 2 Readiness + one existing protection kit; company spends its equipment action
field_power.range: Local encounter; company beside the hero
field_power.duration: Two encounter phases; only one fitted type at a time
field_power.counter: Switch damage type, flank the company, or wait out the temporary fitting.

support_power.name: Temper for the Threat
support_power.effect: Refit one existing company's armor for one declared hazard; improves that resistance by 20% while increasing equipment burden. Replaces its previous special fitting.
support_power.cost: 3 Readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 10M + 5K; metal access, staffed workshop and its queue required
support_power.range: One connected region containing the hero, workshop and company
support_power.duration: One week to fit; persists until replaced or destroyed
support_power.counter: Use other attacks, exploit slower movement, or interrupt the refit.

passive.name: Field Care
passive.effect: One own armored company near the hero suffers 20% less armor-durability loss during its first encounter each week.
passive.limit: One company per week; incoming damage, fitting costs and pre-existing wear are unchanged. Durability is never restored.

retained_weakness: Heavy equipment, slow queues and the need to choose the right protection remain.

compensates: Rare inputs and specialist labor bottleneck tools and commissions.

field_power.name: Exact Breach
field_power.effect: One own engineer company's next obstacle attack gains 25% breach effectiveness when using an existing breach-tool set; its normal wear still applies.
field_power.cost: 2 Readiness; normal engineer action and tool wear
field_power.range: Local encounter; hero beside engineers at the obstacle
field_power.counter: Defend the approach, damage the tools, or move the contested objective.

support_power.name: Modular Refit
support_power.effect: Convert one existing standard tool set to another already-researched compatible function. The original is consumed; rare or unique items are ineligible.
support_power.cost: 3 Readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 10M + 5K; compatible inputs, staffed forge and one queue required
support_power.range: One connected region containing hero, forge and item
support_power.duration: One week; output keeps the input item's salvage-value ceiling
support_power.counter: Interrupt the forge, deny compatible materials, or force a different operational need.

passive.name: Calibrated Grip
passive.effect: One own engineer company beside the hero consumes 25% less breach-tool durability on its first ordinary obstacle attack each week.
passive.limit: One attack per week; normal attack action, tool requirements and recipe inputs remain. No resource refund or durability restoration.

retained_weakness: Rare commissions still require their full inputs, specialist queues and development time.

compensates: Large warbands consume food and divided command can destabilize operations.

field_power.name: Rally the Line
field_power.effect: One own Orc infantry company removes one temporary rout condition and reforms at its current position; wounds and casualty losses remain.
field_power.range: Local encounter; within the hero's command radius
field_power.duration: One reform phase; renewed pressure can rout it again
field_power.counter: Separate the hero, attack during reforming, or threaten another company.

support_power.name: Count the Spoils
support_power.effect: Advance one salvage job started in an earlier turn by one weekly progress step. Consume its finite claimed wreck once; normal salvage yield remains. A job started this turn is ineligible, so this power cannot start and finish a job in the same turn.
support_power.cost: 3 Readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 5P; assigned workers, project order and foundry queue required
support_power.range: One connected region with hero, wreck and receiving foundry
support_power.duration: One weekly resolution; one salvage job
support_power.counter: Recover or destroy the wreck, raid workers, or cut the return route.

passive.name: Declared Shares
passive.effect: One own participating warband avoids a dispute penalty when the player delivers an agreed reward on time.
passive.limit: One fulfilled agreement per week; reward is paid normally and existing grievances remain.

retained_weakness: Food demand, disputed leadership and finite salvage continue to constrain expansion.

compensates: Strong food production supports a community poorly suited to prolonged open battle.

field_power.name: Quiet Departure
field_power.effect: One own civilian or light-infantry group withdraws through existing cover with 25% lower ranged targeting accuracy against it; visibility is not erased.
field_power.range: Local encounter; group near hero and a viable covered exit
field_power.counter: Guard the exit, enter the cover, or attack the destination.

support_power.name: Neighbors' Stores
support_power.effect: Consolidate and move up to 10 existing P from willing own households to one refuge using available carriers; source stores lose the same amount.
support_power.cost: 3 Readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 2P for transport; normal convoy order and carrying capacity required
support_power.range: One connected region with an open route
support_power.duration: One week; no stock duplication or capacity increase
support_power.counter: Block the road, intercept carriers, or threaten the receiving refuge.

passive.name: Packed for Rain
passive.effect: One supplied own civilian convoy accompanied by the hero ignores its first ordinary rain-fatigue increment each week.
passive.limit: One weather event per week; travel time, provisions, carrying capacity and all combat effects remain.

retained_weakness: Weak heavy forces, occupation risk and dependence on defensible refuge routes remain.

compensates: Heavy Troll forces need substantial supplies and struggle to bypass fortifications.

field_power.name: Measured Shatter
field_power.effect: The hero's next normal strike against a gate or barricade gains 25% breach effectiveness but exposes the hero to counterattack.
field_power.range: Local encounter; melee contact with the obstacle
field_power.counter: Use ranged focus, traps, a reserve barrier, or attacks during the exposed recovery.

support_power.name: Clear the Haulway
support_power.effect: Remove one ordinary fallen-stone or timber obstruction from an existing supply route. Cleared debris yields no resource stock.
support_power.cost: 3 Readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 5P + 5M for provisions and tool wear; worker project order required
support_power.range: One connected region; hero physically at the obstruction
support_power.duration: One week; does not create bridges or passages through mountains
support_power.counter: Contest the worksite, attack its supplies, or obstruct another route.

passive.name: Shoulder the Load
passive.effect: The hero carries one existing heavy equipment piece during ordinary movement without requiring a separate porter.
passive.limit: One item; it occupies carrying capacity and prevents sprinting. No added supply ceiling.

retained_weakness: Food consumption, slow repositioning and exposure to coordinated ranged forces remain.

compensates: Lightly protected packs rely on viable hunting territory and coordinated movement.

field_power.name: Split the Pursuit
field_power.effect: Two own wolf groups approaching from different passable directions impose one temporary pursuit penalty on a single isolated enemy company.
field_power.cost: 2 Readiness; both groups spend their normal movement
field_power.range: Local encounter; groups within howling radius
field_power.counter: Close ranks, reach a defended crossing, or support the isolated company.

support_power.name: Read the Hunting Ground
support_power.effect: Survey one connected habitat for existing prey and recent danger; one normally assigned hunting group can choose its route using that report. Harvest still consumes finite prey.
support_power.cost: 3 Readiness + one weekly hero commitment + 2P for the scouting pack; any hunt needs its normal separate order and upkeep
support_power.range: One connected habitat region physically traversable by the hero
support_power.duration: One week; report becomes stale as prey and threats move
support_power.counter: Patrol the hunting route, defend prey areas, or force movement through chokepoints.

passive.name: Recognized Scent
passive.effect: Distinguishes an own pack's recent trail from an unknown trail when the hero encounters it.
passive.limit: Fresh local traces only; reveals no remote position, identity or exact numbers.

retained_weakness: Finite prey, light protection, defended chokepoints and the lack of heavy industry remain.
